title: HD player body: Human male (model, textures, faces, hair, skin colors)
description: Replaces the Human male player model (display 49) with a community HD body via private CreatureModelData row 2366, plus CharSections rows for every skin/face/hair/facial-hair/underwear variation. Built by tools/characters/build_characters.py into mod-source/characters-hd (shared patch-0 payload with the other 15 bodies).

A Retail-derived replacement needs the asset-coverage worker's character-model conversion (retail M2 -> 1.12 format, 5 geoset families, CharSections remap) which is not built yet.
